# First integrated live trial log

Real MCU console output, not synthetic, and NOT a raw radar UART capture.
Original full capture is retained privately; only the curated excerpt is published.
This is the byte slice from first LIVE_STARTED through LIVE_ENDED, plus newline.
The test operator reported readiness to the instructions to restore panel battery power and
walk toward a stationary radar. Both USB sources were already powered.

`live_bench-v1` ran its bounded 20-second trial. Two reports decoded to one
eligible direction-1 target at 3 km/h, rounded to 2 MPH. Status showed
armed=1/fresh=1/mph=2, later armed=1/fresh=0/mph=-1 after no-target reports.
Invalid/UART-error/backlog counters stayed zero. LIVE_ENDED was observed.

The log establishes MCU processing/state transitions. The test operator subsequently
confirmed watching the panel show 2 then go dark, without a camera. This adds
visual confirmation of the first low-duty integration trial; physical clearing
latency was not measured.
Speed accuracy/target identity remain unverified. Preserve this as
decoded integration evidence; parser regression should use raw .bin fixtures.
